Hamare Bare Mein

Udaipur ki mitti se juda,
silver kaari-gari ka ghar

Shree Syam Decor Art saal 2020 mein Udaipur ke Varda Upli Raman, Bahubali Hills ke paas shuru hua. Hum wooden aur silver handicrafts banate hain — jisme 100% pure silver ka istemal hota hai, jo har product ko ek asli royal chamak deta hai.

Hamare kaarigar Rajasthan ki purani takneek se temple, sofa, jhula-chair, photo frame, gift item aur wall watch jaise pieces taiyaar karte hain — jo ghar, showroom ya gift ke liye perfect hain.

  • 100% Pure Silver Handicraft
  • Hath se Tarashi Gayi Design
  • Custom Orders Available
  • Udaipur Made, Rajasthani Virasat
Kya Kya Milta Hai

Hamari Product Categories

01

Temple

Ghar ke mandir ke liye silver-finish temple, jo poojan sthal ko royal roop dete hain.

02

Sofa & Jhula

03

Photo Frame & Mirror

Floral aur peacock motifs se sajaye gaye antique silver frame aur mirror.

04

Wall & Table Clocks

Engraved silver borders wale classic wall clock aur table clock, har ghar ki shaan.

05

Gift Items

Shubh avsar ke liye khaas silver handicraft gift items — shaadi, tyohaar ya corporate gifting.

06

Bajot & Chowki

Elephant-leg aur mother-of-pearl inlay design wale traditional pooja bajot.
